summary: Factory V1 already supports multiple simultaneous non-Stopped programs per owner when baseKeys differ. No contract architecture change required. Product UI and indexer remain single-program.

multipleProgramsPerOwner.constraint: One non-Stopped program per baseKey = keccak256(owner, projectToken, quoteAsset, pair). Different baseKeys may be Active concurrently.

operationalGates.notes: USDT/USDC historically NotActive (LB-G09 gas path). WBNB is the production canary quote. Concurrent TOKEN/WBNB + TOKEN/USDT is allowed once both quotes are enabled and pairs exist.

multipleTokensPerOwner.notes: Different projectToken → different baseKey. No per-owner program count cap. No project-token whitelist in Factory.

programUniquenessRules.duplicatePolicy: Revert DuplicateActiveProgram if existing _activeByBaseKey[baseKey] is non-Stopped

mappingToMissionTerms.completed: NOT an on-chain state — budget depletion does not auto-stop; remainingBudget may reach 0 while lifecycle stays Active

frontendSupport.model: single activeProgram lookup for selected owner+token+quote+pair
